title: Mire: the bear gets stuck
watch: The 10/10 bear hits the toad and is Mired. In the next cycle the bear skips, and the owl takes the turn.
note: Fen Newt isn't built and the scene gives no stats: a plain 2/30 newt stands in, tough enough to last until the bear's next cycle. The bear and owl are filler units with the scene's stats.
